French Railway Signalling for JOSM

This page hosts the French Railway Signalling presets and validator rules for the JOSM editor. The presets help map the railway signalling and infrastructure specific to France in OpenStreetMap / OpenRailwayMap; the validator rules report French signals whose tagging does not follow the Tagging in France scheme.

Preview

×

Presets installation

  1. Open JOSM
  2. Go to Presets → Preset preferences
  3. Search for French Railway Signalling from Available presets
  4. Select the match from the drop-down list
  5. Click the Arrow button to add it to the Active presets list
  6. Click OK to confirm and close the properties

Validator rules

The validator rules are generated from the Tagging in France documentation, reviewed, and published together with the presets. On a French signal, they report:

  • legacy tagging, with a fix that replaces it by the current tags;
  • tags that cannot be combined, such as the two ways of tagging an upward-pointing chevron;
  • railway:signal:* keys that the documentation does not describe;
  • values that the documentation does not list, such as FR:m instead of FR:M (values are case-sensitive).

Values of other schemes, such as Swiss (CH-FDV:) or ETCS (ETCS:) signals, are not checked. JOSM keeps the rules up to date by downloading them again from this site.

Validator rules installation

  1. Open JOSM and go to Edit → Preferences
  2. Select the Data Validator tab, then Tag checker rules
  3. Select French Railway Signalling in Available rules and click the Arrow button to add it to Active rules
  4. If it is not listed yet, click the + button next to Active rules and enter the URL below
  5. Click OK; JOSM checks the changes against the rules before each upload

Rules URL: https://noeldev.github.io/FrenchRailwaySignalling/French_Railway_Signalling.validator.mapcss
